title: Complete proposed kernel and bounded extraction contracts
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Dated source baseline and inferred kernel/extraction design
reviews.disposition: Preserve proposed signatures/manifests vs actual exports; one publisher, retained order/identity, consumer-qualified observer model and durable acknowledgement. Domain registration is not full manifest/rollback/independent engine. Historical source absences and graph counts need current inspection; AD51 qualifies consumer-count gates.
reviews.evidence: Fresh full read 1–end every table, proposed TypeScript/JSON example and foundation fold. Forty-three tests are the dated original lane baseline, not a new run, benchmark or extracted-kernel proof. No new code, original sibling source or current runtime read.
reviews.reopen: An authorized extraction with one actual consumer and observed mismatch/cost; preserve existing facades and trace current affected callers, compatibility and failure-before-publication before broadening.

folds.heading: ## Complete kernel-proposal reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
ER12-K/A/M/C/X/S signatures and descriptors remain inferred design around the dated source baseline. A manifest’s ownership, dependency or writes list does not itself validate cross-owner invariants, provide safe incremental validation, install modules or grant access to stock. Existing registry metadata and region/host enforcement supply narrower seams described by the foundation fold, not proof of the entire reusable kernel. Graph size and missing-export claims need current inputs before reuse (AD32, AD36).

Keep durable write then publication then notification distinct. A subscriber failure after a successful payment cannot safely be represented as a retryable failed payment. Unknown bytes retained opaquely are not executable state; absent required content differs from a genuinely independent optional panel. Preserve old phase/deadline/sequence ordering, live getters, actual consumed time and legacy RNG commitments before a new ordering or async backend changes behavior. A boundary-count cap is not a latency guarantee. These are selected-seam obligations, not a demand to extract the entire game or install a new state store.

AD51 qualifies the old two-/three-consumer wording: use known needs and a first real consumer, with a distinct later case validating the design. A synthetic alternate module can test dependency isolation, but does not establish all-world portability or performance. Current desktop/laptop targets and AD36/AD43 govern selected behavior proof; old 1366×768 and every-step literal-file checks do not add universal gates independent of the actual change. Preserve ER12’s 43-test historical baseline and explicit open graph, lifecycle, loader, async and replay limits. No new extraction, tool adoption, engine rewrite, compatibility decision or priority was selected.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
